note: gaps in OUR archive (days with no snapshot), measured from daily_series_coverage.json; not gaps in the exchange

NBA.basis: last archived full snapshot of each day; per-series market counts

NHL.basis: last archived full snapshot of each day; per-series market counts

CBB.basis: last archived full snapshot of each day; per-series market counts

SOCCER.basis: distinct markets in the last capture batch of each day (horizon-based capture, not a full catalog)
SOCCER.note: horizon-based capture batches; a day without a batch means no capture, not no markets

NFL.basis: open markets in the last full open-set of each day (open only; closed/settled excluded); every 3rd archived day plus the last day (sampled)

MLB.basis: contracts in each daily single-game discovery file (MLB slate days only; offseason/no-game days have no file)
MLB.note: MLB slate days only; offseason days have no discovery file, so gaps are expected after 2026-10-28

CFB.basis: event shards committed on main, keyed by GAME date (event-day coverage, not snapshot-day); history before the current slate not found
CFB.note: event-day keyed by GAME date; only the current slate (2026-10-30..11-14) is archived

TENNIS.basis: OPEN markets in the last run snapshot of each day (open only; settled/closed excluded)
TENNIS.note: open run snapshots start 2026-10-05; Kalshi capture files start 2026-09-11 (quotes/books/trades), so snapshot-based family history is shorter than capture history
